words.sanskrit: atha ha Paingalo Yajnavalkyam upasametya dvadasha varsha shushrusha purvakam

meaning.en: Paingala approached Yajnavalkya, after twelve years of service
meaning.hi: पैंगल याज्ञवल्क्य के पास बारह वर्ष सेवा के बाद आए

words.sanskrit: parama rahasya kaivalyam anubruhi iti papraccha

meaning.en: asked him to teach the deepest secret of liberation
meaning.hi: परम रहस्य, कैवल्य सिखाने को कहा

words.sanskrit: sadeva somya idam agra asit

meaning.en: before all this, dear one, there was only being
meaning.hi: प्रिय, इससे पहले केवल सत् था

words.sanskrit: tat nityam muktam avikriyam satya jnana anandam paripurnam sanatanam ekam eva advitiyam brahma

meaning.en: that eternal, free, unchanging, truth-knowledge-bliss, complete, ancient, one without a second, Brahman
meaning.hi: वह नित्य, मुक्त, अविकारी, सत्य-ज्ञान-आनंद, परिपूर्ण, सनातन, एक अद्वितीय ब्रह्म

words.sanskrit: tasmin maru shuktika sthanu sphatika adau jala raupya purusha rekha adivat mula prakritih asit

meaning.en: within it, like water in a mirage, silver in shell, primal nature existed
meaning.hi: उसमें, मृगतृष्णा के जल या सीप की चाँदी की तरह, मूल प्रकृति थी

words.sanskrit: tat pratibimbitam yat tat sakshi chaitanyam asit

meaning.en: reflected within it was the witnessing consciousness
meaning.hi: उसमें प्रतिबिंबित साक्षी चैतन्य था

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sa punah vikritim prapya

meaning.en: that, undergoing change again
meaning.hi: वह पुनः परिवर्तन को प्राप्त होकर

words.sanskrit: sattva udrikta avyakta akhya avarana shaktih asit

meaning.en: became an unmanifest covering power dominated by clarity
meaning.hi: सत्त्व-प्रधान अव्यक्त आवरण-शक्ति बनी

words.sanskrit: tat pratibimbitam yat tat ishvara chaitanyam asit

meaning.en: reflected within it was the awareness of the Lord
meaning.hi: उसमें प्रतिबिंबित ईश्वर-चैतन्य था

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sa svadhina mayah sarvajnah srishti sthiti layanam adi karta jagat ankura rupah bhavati

meaning.en: he, self-ruled, all-knowing, the primal cause of creation, becomes the sprout of the world
meaning.hi: वह स्वाधीन, सर्वज्ञ, सृष्टि-स्थिति-लय का आदिकर्ता, जगत का अंकुर बनता है

words.sanskrit: pranikarma vashat esha patah yadvat prasaritah pranikarma kshayat punah tirobhavayati

meaning.en: like a cloth spread by action, it retracts when action ends
meaning.hi: कर्मवश फैले कपड़े की तरह, कर्मक्षय पर वापस सिमट जाता है

words.sanskrit: isha adhishthita avarana shaktitah rajah udrikta mahat akhya vikshepa shaktih asit

meaning.en: from that power, ruled by restlessness, arose the projecting power called Mahat
meaning.hi: उस शक्ति से, रजोगुण-प्रधान, महत्तत्व नामक विक्षेप-शक्ति उठी

words.sanskrit: tat pratibimbitam yat tat hiranyagarbha chaitanyam asit

meaning.en: reflected within it was the awareness of Hiranyagarbha
meaning.hi: उसमें प्रतिबिंबित हिरण्यगर्भ-चैतन्य था

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sa mahat tattva abhimani spashta aspashta vapuh bhavati

meaning.en: identified with the great principle, takes a partly clear, partly hazy form
meaning.hi: महत्तत्वाभिमानी स्पष्ट-अस्पष्ट रूप धारण करता है

words.sanskrit: hiranyagarbha adhishthita vikshepa shaktitah tamah udrikta ahankara abhidha sthula shaktih asit

meaning.en: from that power, ruled by heaviness, arose the gross power called ego
meaning.hi: उस शक्ति से तमोगुण-प्रधान अहंकार नामक स्थूल शक्ति उठी

words.sanskrit: tat pratibimbitam yat tat virat chaitanyam asit

meaning.en: reflected within it was the awareness of Virat
meaning.hi: उसमें प्रतिबिंबित विराट-चैतन्य था

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sa tad abhimani spashta vapuh sarva sthula palakah vishnuh pradhana purushah bhavati

meaning.en: identified with that, becomes Vishnu, guardian of all gross things, the primal being
meaning.hi: स्पष्ट रूप धारण किए विष्णु, स्थूल-रक्षक, प्रधान पुरुष बनता है

words.sanskrit: tasmat atmana akashah sambhutah akashat vayuh vayoh agnih agneh apah adbhyah prithivi

meaning.en: from the self came space, from space air, from air fire, from fire water, from water earth
meaning.hi: आत्मा से आकाश, आकाश से वायु, वायु से अग्नि, अग्नि से जल, जल से पृथ्वी

words.sanskrit: pancha ikrita bhutaih ananta koti brahmandani asrijat

meaning.en: with the five-folded elements, he created countless universes
meaning.hi: पंचीकृत तत्वों से अनंत कोटि ब्रह्मांड रचे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sa pancha bhutanam rajah amshan chaturdha kritva pancha vritti atmakam pranam asrijat

meaning.en: dividing the restless portion of the elements fourfold, he created the life-breath with five functions
meaning.hi: तत्वों के रजोंश को चार भागों में बाँटकर पाँच-वृत्ति प्राण रचा

words.sanskrit: sattva amshan chaturdha kritva pancha kriya vritti atmakam antahkaranam asrijat

meaning.en: dividing the clear portion fourfold, he created the mind with five activities
meaning.hi: सत्त्वांश को चार भागों में बाँटकर पाँच-क्रिया अंतःकरण रचा

words.sanskrit: tani srishtani ande prachikshipat

meaning.en: these creations were cast into the cosmic egg
meaning.hi: ये सृष्टियाँ ब्रह्मांडीय अंडे में डाली गईं

words.sanskrit: jivatvam agamat sharira traya tadatmyat kartritva bhoktritvam agamat

meaning.en: took on individual life, identifying with the three bodies as doer and enjoyer
meaning.hi: तीन शरीरों से तादात्म्य कर कर्तृत्व-भोक्तृत्व को प्राप्त हुआ जीवत्व

words.sanskrit: kulala chakra nyayena paribhramati

meaning.en: he wanders endlessly like a potter's wheel
meaning.hi: कुम्हार के चाक की तरह निरंतर घूमता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sarva lokanam srishti sthiti anta krit vibhuh ishah katham jivatvam agamat

meaning.en: how did the all-pervading Lord, creator of all worlds, take on individual life
meaning.hi: सर्वलोकों के सृष्टि-स्थिति-अंतकर्ता ईश्वर जीवत्व को कैसे प्राप्त हुए

words.sanskrit: kapala charma antra asthi mamsa nakhani prithivi amshah

meaning.en: skull, skin, intestines, bones, flesh, nails are portions of earth
meaning.hi: कपाल, चर्म, आंत, अस्थि, मांस, नख पृथ्वी के अंश हैं

words.sanskrit: rakta mutra lala sveda adikam ap amshah

meaning.en: blood, urine, saliva, sweat and the like are portions of water
meaning.hi: रक्त, मूत्र, लाला, स्वेद आदि जल के अंश हैं

words.sanskrit: etat sanghatam sthula shariram bhavati

meaning.en: this gathering becomes the gross body
meaning.hi: यह संघात स्थूल शरीर बनता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: pranam asrijat prana apana vyana udana samanah prana vrittayah

meaning.en: he created the life-breath; prana, apana, vyana, udana, samana are its workings
meaning.hi: प्राण रचा; प्राण, अपान, व्यान, उदान, समान इसकी वृत्तियाँ हैं

words.sanskrit: naga kurma krikara devadatta dhananjayah upapranah

meaning.en: Naga, Kurma, Krikara, Devadatta, Dhananjaya are the supporting breaths
meaning.hi: नाग, कूर्म, कृकर, देवदत्त, धनञ्जय उपप्राण हैं

words.sanskrit: vak pani pada payu upastha tad vrittayah

meaning.en: speech, hands, feet, excretion, generation are their functions
meaning.hi: वाक्, पाणि, पाद, पायु, उपस्थ इनकी वृत्तियाँ हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: antahkaranam manah buddhih chittam ahankarah tad vrittayah

meaning.en: the inner faculty: mind, intellect, memory, ego are its functions
meaning.hi: अंतःकरण: मन, बुद्धि, चित्त, अहंकार इसकी वृत्तियाँ हैं

words.sanskrit: sankalpa nishchaya smarana abhimana anusandhanah tad vishayah

meaning.en: intention, decision, memory, pride, inquiry are their objects
meaning.hi: संकल्प, निश्चय, स्मरण, अभिमान, अनुसंधान इनके विषय हैं

words.sanskrit: shrotra tvak chakshu jihva ghranah tad vrittayah shabda sparsha rupa rasa gandhah tad vishayah

meaning.en: hearing, touch, sight, taste, smell; their objects are sound, touch, form, taste, fragrance
meaning.hi: श्रोत्र, त्वक्, चक्षु, जिह्वा, घ्राण; इनके विषय शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप, रस, गंध हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: annamaya pranamaya manomaya vijnanamaya anandamayah pancha koshah

meaning.en: five sheaths: made of food, breath, mind, understanding, bliss
meaning.hi: पाँच कोश: अन्नमय, प्राणमय, मनोमय, विज्ञानमय, आनंदमय

words.sanskrit: tadeva sthula shariram

meaning.en: that is itself the gross body
meaning.hi: वही स्थूल शरीर है

words.sanskrit: etat kosha trayam linga shariram

meaning.en: these three sheaths together are the subtle body
meaning.hi: ये तीन कोश सूक्ष्म शरीर हैं

words.sanskrit: svarupa ajnanam anandamaya koshah tat karana shariram

meaning.en: ignorance of one's own nature is the bliss sheath, the causal body
meaning.hi: स्वरूप-अज्ञान आनंदमय कोश है, कारण शरीर है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: jnanendriya panchakam karmendriya panchakam prana adi panchakam

meaning.en: five organs of perception, five of action, five vital breaths
meaning.hi: पाँच ज्ञानेंद्रियाँ, पाँच कर्मेंद्रियाँ, पाँच प्राण

words.sanskrit: viyat adi panchakam antahkarana chatushtayam

meaning.en: five elements beginning with space, the fourfold inner faculty
meaning.hi: आकाश आदि पाँच तत्व, चतुर्विध अंतःकरण

words.sanskrit: kama karma tamamsi ashta puram

meaning.en: desire, action, ignorance together form the eight-gated city
meaning.hi: काम, कर्म, तम मिलकर अष्टपुर बनाते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: isha ajnaya virajah vyashti deham pravishya buddhim adhishthaya vishvatvam agamat

meaning.en: by the Lord's command, Virat entered the body, took its seat in intellect, became the universal self
meaning.hi: ईश्वर की आज्ञा से विराट शरीर में प्रवेश कर बुद्धि में स्थित होकर विश्व बना

words.sanskrit: taijasah pratibhasikah svapna kalpitah iti taijasasya nama bhavati

meaning.en: the luminous self, apparent, dream-shaped, is called Taijasa
meaning.hi: तैजस, प्रातिभासिक, स्वप्न-कल्पित, तैजस नाम कहलाता है

words.sanskrit: prajnah vicchinnah paramarthikah sushupti abhimani iti prajnasya nama bhavati

meaning.en: the wise self, undivided, ultimate, absorbed in deep sleep, is called Prajna
meaning.hi: प्राज्ञ, अविच्छिन्न, पारमार्थिक, सुषुप्ति-अभिमानी, प्राज्ञ नाम कहलाता है

words.sanskrit: tattvamasi iti brahmana ekatam jaguh

meaning.en: the phrase that thou art declares oneness with Brahman
meaning.hi: तत्त्वमसि वाक्य ब्रह्म से एकता घोषित करता है

words.sanskrit: jagrat svapna sushupti murccha marana adi avasthah pancha bhavanti

meaning.en: waking, dreaming, deep sleep, fainting, death are the five states
meaning.hi: जाग्रत, स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति, मूर्च्छा, मरण पाँच अवस्थाएँ हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: shabdadi artha vishaya grahana jnanam jagrat avastha bhavati

meaning.en: grasping objects like sound is the waking state
meaning.hi: शब्द आदि विषयों का ग्रहण ज्ञान जागृत अवस्था है

words.sanskrit: bhrumadhyam gatah jivah apada mastakam vyapya kartatvam bhoktritvam cha

meaning.en: the being at the eyebrow-point pervades the body as doer and enjoyer
meaning.hi: भ्रूमध्य में स्थित जीव सिर से पाँव तक व्याप्त होकर कर्ता-भोक्ता बनता है

words.sanskrit: karana uparame jagrat samskara uttha prabodhavat svapna avastha bhavati

meaning.en: when the senses rest, an awakening from waking impressions is the dream state
meaning.hi: इंद्रिय-विराम पर जागृति-संस्कार से उठा जागरण स्वप्न अवस्था है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: chitta eka karana sushupti avastha bhavati

meaning.en: when only the inner faculty remains active, that is deep sleep
meaning.hi: चित्त की एक-मात्र सक्रियता सुषुप्ति अवस्था है

words.sanskrit: bhrama vishranta shakunih pakshau samhritya nidabhimukham yatha gacchati

meaning.en: like a tired bird folding its wings, heading toward its nest
meaning.hi: जैसे थका पक्षी पंख समेटकर घोंसले की ओर जाता है

words.sanskrit: shranto ajnanam pravishya svanandam bhunkte

meaning.en: wearied, enters ignorance and enjoys its own bliss
meaning.hi: थककर अज्ञान में प्रवेश कर स्वानंद भोगता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: akasmat mudgara danda adyaih taditavat bhaya ajnanabhyam murccha bhavati

meaning.en: fear and confusion striking suddenly like a hammer-blow is fainting
meaning.hi: भय-अज्ञान से अचानक हथौड़े जैसी चोट मूर्च्छा है

words.sanskrit: sthula deha visarjani marana avastha bhavati

meaning.en: letting go of the gross body entirely is the death state
meaning.hi: स्थूल देह का पूर्ण त्याग मरण अवस्था है

words.sanskrit: avicharakrito bandho vicharat mokso bhavati tasmat sada vicharayet

meaning.en: bondage comes from lack of reflection, freedom from reflection; always reflect
meaning.hi: अविचार से बंधन, विचार से मोक्ष; सदा विचार करें

words.sanskrit: jiva bhava jagat bhava badhe pratyak abhinnam brahma eva avashishyate

meaning.en: once the sense of separate self and world is set aside, only Brahman remains
meaning.hi: जीव-जगत भाव के बाधित होने पर प्रत्यगभिन्न ब्रह्म ही शेष रहता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: mahavakya vivaranam anubruhi iti

meaning.en: explain the meaning of the great teaching-statements
meaning.hi: महावाक्यों का अर्थ समझाइए

words.sanskrit: tattvamasi tvam tadasi aham brahmasmi iti anusandhanam kuryat

meaning.en: one should reflect on that thou art, I am Brahman
meaning.hi: तत्त्वमसि, अहं ब्रह्मास्मि पर अनुसंधान करना चाहिए

words.sanskrit: vakya artha vicharah shravanam bhavati

meaning.en: inquiry into the statement's meaning is called hearing
meaning.hi: वाक्यार्थ विचार श्रवण कहलाता है

words.sanskrit: ekantena shravana artha anusandhanam mananam bhavati

meaning.en: solitary reflection on that meaning is called deep consideration
meaning.hi: एकांत में श्रवणार्थ अनुसंधान मनन कहलाता है

words.sanskrit: chetah sthapanam nididhyasanam bhavati

meaning.en: fixing the mind steadily is called sustained meditation
meaning.hi: चित्त स्थापन निदिध्यासन कहलाता है

words.sanskrit: dhyeya eka gocharam chittam samadhih bhavati

meaning.en: the mind resting only on the object of meditation is deep absorption
meaning.hi: ध्येय-एकगोचर चित्त समाधि कहलाता है

words.sanskrit: tada jivanmuktah bhavati

meaning.en: at that point, one becomes liberated while living
meaning.hi: तब जीवन्मुक्त होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: ishah pancha ikrita bhutanam apanchi karanam kartum akamayata

meaning.en: the Lord wished to reverse the five-folding of the elements
meaning.hi: ईश ने भूतों के पंचीकरण को उलटने की इच्छा की

words.sanskrit: bhumim jale jalam vahnau vahnim vayau vayum akashe

meaning.en: earth into water, water into fire, fire into air, air into space
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी जल में, जल अग्नि में, अग्नि वायु में, वायु आकाश में

words.sanskrit: andam jnana agnina dagdham karanaih saha paramatmani linam bhavati

meaning.en: the cosmic egg, burned by knowledge's fire, merges with its causes into the Supreme Self
meaning.hi: अंड ज्ञानाग्नि से दग्ध होकर कारणों सहित परमात्मा में लीन होता है

words.sanskrit: angushtha matram atmanam adhuma jyoti rupakam

meaning.en: the self, thumb-sized, smokeless, made of pure light
meaning.hi: अंगुष्ठमात्र आत्मा, धुआँरहित, ज्योतिरूप

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: prakashayantam antahstham dhyayet kutastham avyayam

meaning.en: meditate on the illuminating, unchanging inner self
meaning.hi: प्रकाशित करते अंतःस्थ कूटस्थ अव्यय का ध्यान करें

words.sanskrit: dhyayan aste munih cha eva cha asupteh amritestu yah

meaning.en: the sage resting in this meditation remains immortal even to death
meaning.hi: इस ध्यान में स्थित मुनि मृत्यु तक भी अमृतरूप रहता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: jivanmuktah sah vijneyah sah dhanyah kritakrityavan

meaning.en: he is to be known as liberated while living, blessed, having fulfilled his task
meaning.hi: वह जीवन्मुक्त, धन्य, कृतकृत्य जानना चाहिए

words.sanskrit: jivanmukta padam tyaktva svadehe kalasat krite

meaning.en: having set aside even the liberated identity, when time claims the body
meaning.hi: जीवन्मुक्त पद त्यागकर, शरीर के काल-वश होने पर
